source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: The Neogen command calls init.lua then generator.lua, which locates the Tree-sitter node (function, class) with the locators and node utilities. Language data coming from configurations is injected into a template, for example google_docstrings, converted into a snippet for the chosen engine.
